text:
CL38: two holes let those messages through. I checked both.

1. The orchestrator ran with no hooks at all. O54 was started with two repos (harmonize and board, from your phone). A session started on two repos reads neither repo's .claude/settings.json, so none of the kit's hooks run in it. The message cap, the guards and the say-it-once rule were all off for the orchestrator. Earlier orchestrators started on Harmonize alone. That fits the regression, but I have not checked any of their records.
2. Even in a one-repo session, the board repo's own hook only checked SendMessage, never send_message, the tool web sessions actually use. Its cap was 600, not 200.

Fixed in CL38: the hook covers both tools, caps at 200 characters, and refuses tables and quotes.

Not fixable by a hook: the orchestrator has to start on ONE repo, with the other attached after it starts (you type that once, in the orchestrator's chat). Otherwise every rule is off for it.
